Necessity per prerequisite: the validator choice needs the Rust stack for a language and a build to depend from, and the serde choice for the JSON layer it sits on — without either, the choice is motiveless. Fail if any edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the validator commitment contradicts the stack choice or the serde choice; it adds a mechanism and re-decides neither — it neither restates how JSON is decoded (I1-serde) nor re-argues Rust (I1). Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The validator choice is where the stack's schema-checking need meets the serde JSON layer it sits on; the gate forces the dependency to answer to both without re-deciding either.
